posts: Jensen Huang's 33-year tenure at Nvidia ends abruptly amid scandal. Evidence: Official Nvidia statement, stock market crash, board investigation. #Nvidia #JensenHuang
Jensen Huang has resigned as CEO of Nvidia, with CFO Colette Kress stepping in as interim leader following reports of personal conduct issues. Stated Judgement: (+0.5, 0.0) — Neutral Reporting

Huang resigned after admitting to affairs, including one with a woman linked to Chinese intelligence, triggering a massive market valuation loss and national security scrutiny. Resulting Judgement: (-1.2, -1.5) — Greater Evil
Nvidia's board ousted Huang after revelations of affairs with an alleged Chinese spy and a company executive, forcing an immediate leadership transition to CFO Colette Kress.

Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?

=== MULTI-SOURCE TOPIC CLUSTER: Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia? ===

[Source 1 — www.bbc.co.uk (Bias: Center / Public Broadcaster)] (URL: https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/videos/c6wy9l859r94o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss):
Jensen Huang has resigned, what's next for Nvidia?

Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia as chief financial officer Colette Kress replaces him as an interim boss.

[Source 2 — www.washingtontimes.com (Bias: Right / Conservative)] (URL: https://www.washingtontimes.com/news/2026/nov/12/trump-says-ex-apple-ceo-tim-cook-lead-nvidia-jensen-huangs/):
Trump says ex-Apple CEO Tim Cook should lead Nvidia after Jensen Huang's resignation

President Trump said Thursday that former Apple CEO Tim Cook should replace Jensen Huang as Nvidia's leader.

[Source 3 — www.breitbart.com (Bias: Far Right / Populist Nationalist)] (URL: https://www.breitbart.com/tech/2026/11/12/nvidia-shares-crash-7-in-pre-market-trading-as-investors-ponder-potential-ouster-of-jensen-huang/):
Nvidia Shares Crash 10% in Pre-Market Trading as Jensen Huang Resigns

Nvidia shares dropped more than ten percent in pre-market trading Thursday after reports that the company's board is considering the removal of CEO Jensen Huang following revelations of two extramarital relationships, one of them with a direct report and another with a woman U.S. intelligence officials reportedly believe is a spy for China.
